reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "Strength training is one of the best things you can do through menopause. It helps hold on to muscle and bone, and many women do well with steady lifting plus enough protein and sleep. What's right for your body, including how you're feeling day to day, is a conversation for your doctor. Tell me what you'd like to train for and how many days you have, and I'll build it."}
